一.meaning: A single Ground line represents the beginning, the foundation upon which everything is built.
一.onyomi: Ichiro meticulously lays the first brick, starting a new construction project.
一.kunyomi: Hito — 'hee-toe' — a single toe points the way forward.

二.meaning: Two Grounds stacked together symbolize duality, a pair, a contrasting force.
二.onyomi: Ni, the twins, mirror each other’s every move, a perfect pair.
二.kunyomi: Futa — 'foo-tah' — two feet shuffle across the floor.

九.meaning: Nine Ground lines form a complex, layered structure, representing completeness and finality.
九.onyomi: Kyu, the student, is late to class for the ninth time, a pattern of repetition.
九.kunyomi: Kokono — 'ko-ko-no' — nine coconuts tumble from the tree.

七.meaning: Seven lines twist and intertwine, a complex and unpredictable journey.
七.onyomi: Shichi, the wind, swirls erratically, changing direction every moment.
七.kunyomi: Nana — 'nah-nah' — a child sings a simple, repetitive tune.

人.meaning: A Person stands upright, a figure of humanity, full of potential and complexity.
人.onyomi: Jin, the performer, takes a bow after a stunning performance.
人.kunyomi: Hito — 'hee-toe' — a single person walks down the street.

入.meaning: A Person enters a doorway, signifying passage, acceptance, or beginning.
入.onyomi: Nyu, the traveler, steps through the gate of a new city.
入.kunyomi: I — 'ee' — a single step into a room.

八.meaning: Eight Fins dance in a swirling pattern, representing abundance and growth in the ocean.
八.onyomi: Hachi, the octopus, extends all eight arms to grab a tasty treat.
八.kunyomi: Ya — 'yah' — a wave crashes onto the shore.

十.meaning: A Cross forms the shape of Ten, symbolizing completion, culmination, and a full cycle.
十.onyomi: Juu, the leader, surveys his kingdom from a high tower.
十.kunyomi: Too — 'too' — ten toes wiggle in the sand.

三.meaning: A Ground line above Two signifies a trinity, a group of three, a combined force.
三.onyomi: Zoo, the trio, harmonizes their voices in a beautiful song.
三.kunyomi: Mi — 'mee' — three mice scurry across the floor.

上.meaning: A Toe above a Ground line indicates elevation, ascent, or something being above.
上.onyomi: Jyou, the climber, reaches the summit of the mountain.
上.kunyomi: Ue — 'oo-eh' — a bird flies above the trees.

下.meaning: Eve, tripping on a stray Toe, stumbles down from the elevated Ground — a descent.
下.onyomi: Kaoru carefully descends the stairs, checking each step.
下.kunyomi: Shita — 'she taught' — she taught me how to descend safely.

大.meaning: Carlos, overwhelmed by the sheer size of the Big building, proclaims it truly Large.
大.onyomi: Tai struggles to carry a huge box, overwhelmed by its size.
大.kunyomi: Oki — 'oh key' — he lost the key to the big door.

女.meaning: Selma, a proud Woman, stands firm, refusing to be moved.
女.onyomi: Jyo stares intently, a female performer on stage.
女.kunyomi: Onna — 'own-ah' — she owns the best bakery in town.

山.meaning: Sho, a laid-back surfer, admires the majestic Mountain from the shore.
山.onyomi: Senna raced through the mountain pass, a blur of speed.
山.kunyomi: Yama — 'yah ma' — you ma'am, watch out for the mountain lion!

川.meaning: Kofi, the carpenter, builds a tiny raft to float down the River.
川.onyomi: Sen swims across the river with powerful strokes.
川.kunyomi: Kawa — 'ka-wah' — a warm wave washes over the riverbank.

土.meaning: Tova, the farmer, digs deep into the Dirt to plant her seeds.
土.onyomi: Do struggles to move a heavy stone, covered in earth.
土.kunyomi: Tsuchi — 'too-chee' — too much dirt gets on his shoes.

千.meaning: Kin, the goldsmith, meticulously counts out a Thousand tiny gold flakes.
千.onyomi: Senna drove a thousand laps around the track.
千.kunyomi: Chi — 'chee' — he chipped away at the clay.

子.meaning: Kiki, the Belgian girl, playfully hides a little Child behind a bush.
子.onyomi: Shi, the doctor, carefully examines a young patient.

小.meaning: Fuad, the merchant, displays a Small trinket, hoping to entice a buyer.
小.onyomi: Shoo steps delicately, a tiny dancer on stage.

中.meaning: Homer, after an accident, finds himself trapped in the Middle of the room.
中.onyomi: Chu, the chef, expertly mixes ingredients in the middle of his kitchen.
中.kunyomi: Naka — 'nah-kah' — he's in the middle of a nap.

五.meaning: Five tiny Five spirits danced around a bonfire, celebrating their collective number.
五.onyomi: Goro the geisha meticulously counts five cherry blossoms in a vase.

六.meaning: A Lid covered a pool, but six Fins darted out from beneath, eager for a swim.
六.onyomi: Roku the robber carefully counts six diamonds before escaping.
六.kunyomi: Mu — 'moo' — a cow moos six times before settling down.

円.meaning: A Lid balanced perfectly on a Head, creating a perfect Circle.
円.onyomi: Enzo the explorer charts a circular route through the jungle.
円.kunyomi: Maru — 'mar' — a boat circles around the harbor.

天.meaning: A lone Heaven figure gazed down, contemplating the vastness of the cosmos.
天.onyomi: Ten-year-old Tova practices calligraphy, depicting the vastness of the heavens.
天.kunyomi: Amatsu — 'ah-mah-tsoo' — an ancient legend tells of a messenger from the heavens.

日.meaning: The Sun shone brightly, marking the beginning of a new Day.
日.onyomi: Nico the novelist begins writing a new story each day.
日.kunyomi: Hi — 'high' — the sun is high in the sky.

月.meaning: The Moon hung in the night sky, illuminating a peaceful Month.
月.onyomi: Getsu the gardener tends to his moon-shaped garden.
月.kunyomi: Tsuki — 'tsu-key' — the moon's light guides you through the night.

木.meaning: A single Tree stood tall and proud, its roots firmly planted in the earth.
木.onyomi: Boku the boxer trains relentlessly, striking like a tree trunk.
木.kunyomi: Ki — 'key' — the key is hidden beneath the tree.

水.meaning: Water flowed steadily downhill, carving a path through the rocks.
水.onyomi: Sui the swimmer effortlessly glides through the water.
水.kunyomi: Mizu — 'meez' — a glass of water quenches your thirst.

火.meaning: A raging Fire consumed the forest, leaving behind a trail of ash.
火.onyomi: Kaori the chef skillfully manages the fire beneath her wok.
火.kunyomi: Hi — 'he' — the fire is too hot.

出.meaning: A lone figure emerged from a Mountain pass, disappearing into the valley below.
出.onyomi: Shutsu the student cautiously exits the classroom.
出.kunyomi: De — 'dee' — you decide to exit the building.

右.meaning: A Narwhal, confused by the direction, opens its Mouth and points towards a distant shore — it's the Right way to go.
右.onyomi: Yusuf sketches a map, marking the Right direction with a flourish.
右.kunyomi: Migi — 'me gee' — you see a mischievous cat sneaking off to the right.

四.meaning: Four Legs stomp across the floor of the Mouth, creating a rhythmic beat.
四.onyomi: Sho carves a surfboard, meticulously shaping it into a perfect four-point star.
四.kunyomi: Yoru — 'yore' — you see four shadows stretching long on the floor.

左.meaning: A Narwhal swims left, bumping into a half-built Construction, forcing it to turn.
左.onyomi: Sasa scores a home run, sliding left into third base.
左.kunyomi: Hidari — 'hee-dah-ree' — you notice the left-hand side of the building is damaged.

本.meaning: A Book rests on a sturdy wooden stool, a symbol of knowledge and wisdom.
本.onyomi: Homer meticulously organizes a library, stacking books neatly.
本.kunyomi: Moto — 'moh-toh' — you find the original manuscript in the dusty archives.

白.meaning: A single White feather drifts down, illuminating the dark corner of a room.
白.onyomi: Byakuya, a stoic samurai, wears white armor.
白.kunyomi: Shiro — 'she-roh' — you see a white bird perched on a branch.

万.meaning: A single Leaf falls, scattering like a thousand Swords across the ground.
万.onyomi: Ban, a powerful warlord, commands a vast army.
万.kunyomi: Yorozu — 'yor-oh-zoo' — you have a thousand different flavors of ice cream.

今.meaning: The Now moment is a fleeting glimpse of a hand reaching out, grasping at time.
今.onyomi: Kyo carefully prepares a tea ceremony, focusing on the present moment.
今.kunyomi: Ima — 'ee-mah' — you feel the warmth of the sun on your face right now.

午.meaning: A Slide down a grassy hill leads directly to a sun-baked Dry patch of earth at noon.
午.onyomi: Go, the train departs precisely at noon.
午.kunyomi: Uma — 'oo-mah' — you see a horse grazing peacefully in the pasture.

友.meaning: A Narwhal swims alongside a wooden Stool, creating a bond of unlikely friendship.
友.onyomi: Yusuf shares a laugh with his friend over a cup of tea.
友.kunyomi: Tomo — 'toh-moh' — you’re always together with your best friend.

父.meaning: A Father stands strong, a symbol of protection and guidance.
父.onyomi: Fuad carefully inspects his wares, haggling with a smile.
父.kunyomi: Chichi — 'chee-chee' — you remember your father's kind voice.

北.meaning: A Fingers carefully points the Spoon towards the distant horizon — indicating the direction of North.
北.onyomi: Homer gets hopelessly lost, shouting 'North! North!'
北.kunyomi: Kita — 'key-tah' — you kick a key into the snow and lose it in the north.

半.meaning: A Triceratops only eats half of its food, leaving the other half for the Dry desert winds to carry away.
半.onyomi: Hans meticulously divides a blueprint in half, ensuring perfect symmetry.
半.kunyomi: Naka — 'nah-kah' — you take a nap and only wake up halfway through.

外.meaning: As Evening descends, a single Toe steps out of the doorway, venturing into the unknown.
外.onyomi: Gai feels a breeze on his face as he steps outside.
外.kunyomi: Soto — 'soh-toh' — you see something out of the window.

母.meaning: The Sun warms the Drop of tears on a mother’s cheek, a testament to her endless love.
母.onyomi: Bo sighs with contentment, remembering his mother.
母.kunyomi: Haha — 'hah-hah' — a baby laughs at their mother.

休.meaning: The Leader leans against the Tree, finally able to rest after a long day’s work.
休.onyomi: Kyu finds a quiet spot to rest and recuperate.
休.kunyomi: Yasu — 'yah-soo' — you easily relax into a comfortable chair.

先.meaning: A Slide leads down to the Dirt, marking the path for those who come before.
先.onyomi: Senna accelerates, taking the lead on the racetrack.
先.kunyomi: Saki — 'sah-kee' — you quickly grab the first slice of cake.

名.meaning: The Evening shadows dance around the Mouth, whispering a legendary tale.
名.onyomi: Mei announces the winner of the competition.
名.kunyomi: Nama — 'nah-mah' — you name a new puppy.

年.meaning: A Gun points to the Cow grazing in the field, marking the passage of another Year.
年.onyomi: Nen marks the anniversary with a solemn reflection.
年.kunyomi: Toshi — 'toh-shee' — you wash your clothes every year.

気.meaning: The Energy of the Treasure shines brightly, illuminating the room with its vibrant aura.
気.onyomi: Ki fills the air with a palpable tension.
気.kunyomi: Iki — 'ee-kee' — you quickly inhale the fresh air.

百.meaning: A Leaf floats down from the Sun, representing a hundred blessings.
百.onyomi: Hyaku counts the grains of rice one by one.
百.kunyomi: Momo — 'moh-moh' — you pick a hundred peaches from the tree.

男.meaning: A farmer plants Rice in the paddy, needing immense Power to cultivate the land and provide for his family.
男.onyomi: Dan, the construction worker, flexes his muscles, demonstrating incredible strength.
男.kunyomi: Otoko — 'oh-toe-koh' — you notice a strong man's footprints in the soft earth.

見.meaning: Eve, the botanist, carefully 'See's a rare flower blooming, her gaze intense and unwavering.
見.onyomi: Kenji, the photographer, adjusts his lens, trying to capture the perfect view.
見.kunyomi: Mi — 'me' — you blink your eyes to see better.

車.meaning: Carlos, the street vendor, pushes his cart - a simple Car - through the bustling market, dodging pedestrians.
車.onyomi: Showa, the race car driver, speeds around the track.
車.kunyomi: Kuruma — 'koo-roo-mah' — you notice the car's wheels turning.

毎.meaning: Homer, always clumsy, accidentally shoots a Window with a Gun while trying to hang a picture – it’s a 'Every'day occurrence.
毎.onyomi: Mai, the dancer, practices her routine every day.
毎.kunyomi: Goto — 'go-toe' — you step onto a patch of ground every day.

行.meaning: Kyo, the tea master, gracefully 'Go'es through the ritual, each movement precise and deliberate.
行.onyomi: Kofi, the carpenter, uses his hands to guide the wood as he goes.

西.meaning: Sho, the surfer, rides the waves toward the 'West', searching for the perfect break.
西.onyomi: Sai, the fortune teller, points West, predicting a journey.
西.kunyomi: Nishi — 'nee-shee' — you turn to the west and see the setting sun.

何.meaning: Hans, the engineer, meticulously checks the manual, questioning 'What' is the correct procedure for this complex assembly.
何.onyomi: Ka, the street vendor, calls out his wares.

来.meaning: Rio, the backpacker, arrives with a flourish, announcing her 'Come'ing to a new city.
来.onyomi: Tai, the rugby player, charges forward.
来.kunyomi: Kita — 'kee-tah' — you arrive at your destination.

学.meaning: Kyu, the late student, frantically 'Study's notes, hoping to catch up on the lesson.
学.onyomi: Gaku, the professor, lectures with authority.
学.kunyomi: Mana — 'mah-nah' — you learn a new fact.

金.meaning: Kin, the goldsmith, carefully shapes a piece of Gold, creating a beautiful and valuable work of art.
金.onyomi: Kin, the Vietnamese goldsmith, polishes a gold ring.
金.kunyomi: Kane — 'kah-nay' — you hear the sound of a ringing bell.

雨.meaning: A single Rain drop falls from the sky, splattering onto the ground, creating a puddle — a sudden shower.
雨.onyomi: Ugo rushes outside, shielding himself from the rain.
雨.kunyomi: Ame — 'ah-meh' — you always remember to bring an umbrella.

国.meaning: The King stands before his people, proclaiming his rule over the land – a sovereign Country.
国.onyomi: Koko surveys his vast empire with a proud smile.
国.kunyomi: Kuni — 'koo-nee' — you're known in the country.

東.meaning: A lone Tree stands silhouetted against the rising Sun, marking the direction of the East.
東.onyomi: Tova surveys her fields, watching the sunrise in the east.

長.meaning: A Long branch extends from the tree, symbolizing growth and duration.
長.onyomi: Cho carefully measures the length of the bamboo stalk.

前.meaning: Horns jut out from the ground, a marker before a vast, open Ground, signaling what lies ahead.
前.onyomi: Kyo bows formally, standing before the tea master.

南.meaning: A Cross guides the way, pointing towards the Head of a vast land, marking the direction of the South.
南.onyomi: Nana sets off to the south, searching for a new adventure.

後.meaning: Loiterers linger, dropping Poop while a Winter storm brews behind them – the end of something.
後.onyomi: Kofi considers what lies behind him, a trail of memories.

食.meaning: A hungry person Eat's with gusto, devouring a feast.
食.onyomi: Jiro eagerly anticipates his next meal.

校.meaning: A Tree shelters a Lid, protecting the knowledge passed down from the Father – a place of learning.
校.onyomi: Kyo meticulously organizes the textbooks for the school.

時.meaning: The Sun casts a long shadow across the Temple, marking the passage of Time.
時.onyomi: Jiro checks his watch obsessively, always worried about time.
時.kunyomi: Toki — 'toe-key' — you stub your toe on the temple keystone every time.

高.meaning: The Lid carefully covered the Mustache’s mouth, silencing his complaints about the view from the top of the hill – a majestic, elevated height.
高.onyomi: Kofi, the carpenter, built a tower so high it seemed to touch the sky.
高.kunyomi: Taka – 'toe-kah' – you feel a sudden, tall ache in your toes after climbing a steep hill.

間.meaning: The Sun peeked through the Gate, marking the precise Interval between dawn and daybreak.
間.onyomi: Kan, the warlord, measured the distance between his troops with meticulous precision.
間.kunyomi: Aida – 'eye-dah' – the space between two eyes is a significant interval.

話.meaning: Saying something to the Tongue brought forth a lively Tale, full of gossip and laughter.
話.onyomi: Waka – 'wah-kah' – Yolanda’s opera performance was full of dramatic storytelling.
話.kunyomi: Hanashi – 'hah-nah-shee' – a quick, playful 'ha-ha' is a simple tale.

電.meaning: Rain fell onto the Rice Paddy, and someone held up an Umbrella to collect the energy – a spark of electricity.

聞.meaning: To truly Hear, one must open the Gate and focus on the sound entering the Ear.
聞.onyomi: Bun, the surfer, listened carefully to the ocean’s rumble before catching a wave.
聞.kunyomi: Ki – 'key' – the key to understanding is to listen carefully.

語.meaning: Saying a Word to the Five mouths created a story that was shared and retold.
語.onyomi: Go – 'go' – Sosa hits a home run, shouting words of victory to the crowd.
語.kunyomi: Kata – 'kah-tah' – a few simple words can be a concise and important statement.

読.meaning: To Read, one must sell their attention to the sun's message on the page.
読.onyomi: Doku – 'doe-koo' – Kyo meticulously reads the ancient scrolls, searching for hidden meaning.
読.kunyomi: Yo – 'yo' – a quick 'yo!' of understanding when you read something new.

生.meaning: A single Life began, a tiny spark of vitality and growth.
生.onyomi: Sei – 'say' – Selma firmly believes in the sanctity of life.
生.kunyomi: I – 'ee' – a single, quiet 'ee' of wonder at the miracle of life.

書.meaning: Using a Brush to capture the Sun's light creates a written message.
書.onyomi: Sho – 'show' – Sosa showed off his calligraphy skills to the admiring crowd.
書.kunyomi: Ka – 'kah' – a quick, simple 'ka' to indicate something is written.
